rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something earlier or previous.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 zi1 cin4 ge3 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use this when prior means more important or significant than something else.

example.english: This matter is prior in importance to paying the rent.
example.jyutping: ni1 joeng6 je5 bei2 gaau1 zou1 zung6 jiu3 di1
